entities.name: HIV-1 Env gp160
observations: 768-aa sequence has 82.1% identity and 100% query coverage to reviewed HIV-1 subtype C Env gp160 UniProt O12164.
Sequence-derived properties: predicted molecular mass 86.9 kDa and pI 9.01; values exclude processing and post-translational modifications.
Env precursor is cleaved by host furin-like proteases into gp120 surface and gp41 transmembrane subunits.
gp120 mediates CD4 attachment and subsequent coreceptor engagement; gp41 drives viral-host membrane fusion.
Mature Env forms a trimer of noncovalently associated gp120-gp41 heterodimers; reference annotation localizes it to viral and host membranes as a type I membrane protein.
This query is shorter than the homologous reference Env; reference cleavage and topology positions are approximate, not mapped experimentally onto this sequence.

entities.name: HIV-1 gp120
observations: Env surface subunit that mediates viral attachment to host CD4 and facilitates chemokine coreceptor engagement; mature Env contains gp120 paired with gp41.

entities.name: HIV-1 gp41
observations: Env transmembrane subunit and class I viral fusion protein; conformational rearrangement promotes fusion of viral and host membranes.
